verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST API for querying logged requests (POST /v1/request/query) and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so an agent could programmatically pull request and trace data; HQL is also listed as a query language. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server or API access to aggregated metrics or eval results. Missing for 10: an official MCP server, documented API access to metrics and eval results, session/trace-level query endpoints, and hands-on evidence of agent-driven debugging.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app
